What We Do

Concrete services

From the first stake in the ground to the final broom finish, our crew handles the full job.

01

Foundations

Slab-on-grade, post-tension and pier & beam foundations for new homes and additions.

02

Slabs

Garage, shop, warehouse and commercial floor slabs, properly graded and reinforced.

03

Driveways

New driveways and tear-out & replace, with clean control joints and durable finishes.

04

Patios & Sport Courts

Backyard patios, extensions and basketball courts — plain, stamped or stained.

05

Sidewalks & Flatwork

Walkways, curbs, approaches and general flatwork for residential and commercial sites.

06

Repair & Replacement

Removal of cracked or sunken concrete and a clean, long-lasting replacement pour.

About Us

Concrete done right the first time

JGM Foundation LLC is a hands-on concrete company. We show up when we say we will, keep the job site clean, and treat every slab like it's going under our own home.

  • Proper site prep, compaction and forming
  • Correct rebar, cable and vapor barrier placement
  • Quality ready-mix and professional finishing
  • Straight answers and on-time scheduling
